edges.reason: msg.sender is packed into the keccak256 randomness input, so any caller can influence the draw.
block.timestamp (now) feeds _randModulus, making the random outcome timestamp dependent.
now and block.difficulty are the entropy source of the weak pseudo-random generator.
_randModulus derives randomness from keccak256 over now/block.difficulty, which is predictable and miner-influenceable.
nonce is read as part of the random hash input.
nonce is incremented after each random draw.
mod parameter bounds the returned random value.
seed parameter is mixed into the random hash input.
rand local holds the computed pseudo-random result.
constructor sets gameStarted to false.
Initial mint pays the total supply to msg.sender.
Constructor invokes _mint for the 10,000 * 1e18 supply.
_liquidityPool parameter is stored by startGame.
_seed1 parameter seeds the game randomness.
startGame writes the liquidityPool state variable.
startGame writes seed1.
startGame writes the derived seed2.
startGame sets chanceRate to 100.
startGame flips gameStarted to true.
startGame calls _randModulus to compute seed2.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender(), restricting startGame to the owner.
recipient parameter flows into transfer.
amount parameter flows into transfer.
msg.sender is forwarded as the sender argument to _getAmount from transfer.
transfer calls _getAmount to compute the effective amount.
sender parameter flows into transferFrom.
recipient parameter flows into transferFrom.
amount parameter flows into transferFrom.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked in transferFrom.
transferFrom calls _getAmount to compute the effective amount.
hasGameStarted returns gameStarted.
recipient parameter used for reward payout.
sender parameter used for liquidity pool comparison and burn.
amount parameter is adjusted by reward and burn.
burnAmount is subtracted from the amount returned by _getAmount.
gameStarted gates whether reward and burn logic execute at all.
_getAmount invokes _sendReward before burning.
_getAmount invokes _getRandomBurnedAmount.
_getAmount performs the state-changing _burn on the sender inside the transfer flow after the reward mint.
amount parameter multiplied by 10 for the reward.
sender parameter compared with liquidityPool.
recipient parameter receives the minted reward.
liquidityPool state variable is compared against the sender to trigger rewards.
_sendReward calls _play to decide whether the reward is won.
_sendReward mints new tokens before the burn is applied in _getAmount, an unsafe ordering of state effects.
amount parameter is divided to derive the burn.
burnrate local randomly scales the burn percentage.
seed2 is the seed used to derive the burn rate.
_getRandomBurnedAmount calls _randModulus for the burn rate.
val1 is the first random draw compared in _play.
val2 is the second random draw compared in _play.
seed1 is used for the first draw.
seed2 is used for the second draw.
_play calls _randModulus twice to obtain the compared values.
